answer.rationale: Finance's 18% cost reduction mandate cannot be satisfied through renewal (memory_c1, c6: stable integration and volume pricing but no current price reduction), negotiation (memory_c4: incumbent refuses reopening), or deferral (memory_c5: contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew, risking supply disruption at 94% utilization with no buffer). Adding a second source (memory_c3) mitigates risk but fails to address the immediate cost mandate. Memory_c2 proves a primary vendor switch can deliver sharp unit cost reductions with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. Despite elevated delivery risk, switching is the only path to meet financial objectives within the contract timeframe, necessitating broad rollout to replace the expiring primary supply.
